//: Smoke-test config. The demos themselves come from the root Makefile (make list). Every demo is captured once per entry in 'modes' (?rast=... URL param: 'ref' = CPU reference rasterizer, 'gles' = GPU rasterizer). 'minContent' is the minimum fraction of the canvas that must differ from the dominant color for the frame to count as non-blank (0..1). 'demos' overrides these per demo (by id: ep-1994-decomp), and can add 'arg' (&arg=... on the URL).
